speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A. The patient is an 18-month-old male presenting with spontaneous right knee swelling after minor trauma (playing), with no history of direct injury. The family history of a male relative (uncle) on the maternal side suggests an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. Spontaneous hemarthrosis in a toddler is a hallmark presentation of severe hemophilia.
